Our client is looking for Agentic AI Engineer to build and deploy AI agents that automate real business workflows reducing operational cost, headcount dependency, and turnaround time. This is a hands-on implementation role, not R&D. If your experience lives in notebooks, courses, and demos, this role is not for you.
What Youll Own
Design and build multi-agent systems that replace or augment manual business processes
Integrate agents with internal tools (CRM, ERP, databases, APIs, communication platforms)
Optimize agent performance for cost per task token efficiency, latency, and accuracy
Set up observability and monitoring so agents dont fail silently in production
Work directly with business stakeholders to translate process pain points into agent workflows
Maintain and iterate on deployed agents not a build-and-forget role
Minimum 2 production-deployed agentic systems not POCs, not demos, not coursework. Real systems, real users, real business impact. You must be able to speak to what broke, how you fixed it, and what it saved
Proficiency in Python, LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent orchestration frameworks
Experience with tool-calling, RAG pipelines, memory management, and multi-agent coordination
Familiarity with MCP servers and API integrations
Cost-aware engineering mindset can justify model choice (when to use GPT-4o vs Haiku vs Sonnet) based on task requirements, not preference
Understanding of guardrails, human-in-the-loop design, and failure handling
How We Evaluate You Interview Process
Theory will not get you through. Expect:
Production walkthrough show us a live or previously deployed agent. Walk us through the architecture, what failed, and how you resolved it
Cost breakdown explain the token/compute cost of a system you built and how you optimized it
Live build task given a business process, design an agent workflow on the spot
What Good Looks Like
Agents running in production, not in slides
Clear ROI per agent time saved, cost reduced, error rate dropped
Builds lean chooses the cheapest model that does the job reliably, not the most impressive one
What Will Get You Rejected
Portfolio of tutorials and Jupyter notebooks with no deployment history
Can explain LangChain architecture but never shipped one to production
Optimizes for technical elegance over business outcome
What You Wont Be Doing
Academic research or model training
Waiting for perfect requirements expected to drive clarity from ambiguous briefs
Building without a business case
Remote working
At Substance, we re all about action, not just talk. If your profile aligns with what we need, you ll hear from us within 1-2 weeks. If not, no fluff just know we value your interest and will keep you in mind for future roles where your skills can make an impact. We focus on real connections and meaningful matches, so when the right opportunity comes, we ll be ready to make it happen.

The role focuses on leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technology, integrating APIs, and optimizing AI models for production. Proven experience integrating APIs and AI frameworks into applications

Proficiency in Python and AI/ML libraries (e
g
, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face)
Experience with API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc
) and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex

Familiarity with model fine-tuning, testing, and deployment in production environments
Certifications (Optional):AI/ML certifications or cloud-based AI certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure) are a plus

Other Requirements:

Strong collaboration skills to work with AI, backend, and product teams
Problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and high coding standards
Excellent analytical, documentation, and communication skills

jobs.job_description:
Profile :

We are hiring a world-class Prompt Engineer, someone with extreme clarity of thought, deep reasoning skills, and hands-on mastery of modern LLM behavior. It is for someone who understands prompting as a science : evaluation, ablation, latency tuning, hallucination control, guardrails and AGI-aligned orchestration.

Requirements :

- Exceptional reasoning, logic structuring and analytical thinking.

- Ability to design deterministic, controlled, and testable prompts for production behaviour.

- Deep understanding of temperature, top-p, top-k, seed, max-tokens, repetition penalty, and their effects on model behaviour.

- Strong mastery of LLM guardrails, prompt-injection defense, role separation, Meta Logic, and system level prompt design.

- Solid understanding of modern LLMs and NLP systems (GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.).

- Knowledge of low-latency model families, quantization (GGUF, INT4/8), and inference trade-offs.

- Clear understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector DBs including when not to use them.

- Ability to run evaluation pipelines (accuracy, F1, hallucination rate, consistency, JSON validity).

- Highly detail-oriented, structured thinker, fast learner.

- Strong communication, able to explain reasoning clearly and concisely.

- Comfortable building measurable experiments instead of intuition-based prompting.

Responsibilities :

- Design high-accuracy prompts for reasoning, extraction, classification, and multi-step workflows.

- Build robust system + user prompt architectures with strict constraints and safety layers.

- Run temperature, seed, sampling, and ordering ablations to achieve deterministic and stable performance.

- Optimize prompts for latency, consistency, cost, and token efficiency.

- Reduce hallucinations using verification loops, guardrails, retrieval control, and role conditioning.

- Architect governing instructions for multi-agent systems and AGI-aligned assistants.

- Build hierarchical prompt layers (system -meta-controller - task-level - tools).

- Select models based on latency, throughput, context window, and domain-specific performance.

- Collaborate with AI engineers on quantization, distillation, caching, and runtime optimizations.

- Maintain versioned prompt libraries with clear documentation, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.

- Work closely with ML, product, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade, scalable prompt flows.

- Write clear technical documents : architecture diagrams, ablation summaries, evaluation reports, and runbooks.
